verdicts.reason: The two are nearly identical. Both read left to right: logo, phone, headline, CTA. Shared flaws in both: the tilted 'LONGEST DAY SALE' ribbon runs off the left edge and floats unanchored below the logo; the decorative circles are cropped into the top-left corner; '25% off on June 21.' is squeezed against the CTA and wraps awkwardly; the legal block is tiny, crammed against the right edge and visually competes with the CTA; the phone nearly touches the bottom edge. A is very slightly better because its ribbon sits higher with more room. In B the ribbon drops toward the bottom edge, which makes the lower-left corner more cramped.
